title: Aegis endorsement record, JSON form (aegis-endorsement-v1)
description: An endorser's signed statement that one ML-DSA-65 key is the identity key of one device (common/endorsement.py, docs/enrolment.md): written by `provision/aegis_provision.py endorse`, installed by `fleet.py enroll-endorsed`. The signature is ML-DSA-65 by the endorser over "aegis-endorsement-v1" || 0x00 || canonical(body), canonical = JSON with sorted keys and no spaces (common/wire.py). Every key is known: a verifier refuses a record or a body with one it does not know. The COSE form (aegis-endorsement-cose-v1, a CBOR file starting 0xd2) carries the same body as EAT claims: docs/data-formats.md.

device_pk.description: the device's 1952-byte public key, hex; not under the signature (the body names its SHA-256). enroll-endorsed needs it.

kind.description: the policy kind; a record of another kind never matches an entry (the record itself only requires a short text)

profile.description: the claims profile, for the plain-claims kinds; absent for aegis-pq. The development profile cannot be endorsed.

measurements.description: what the device reported at the bench and the endorser found in its reference values; one per type

token_sha3_256.description: SHA3-256 of the bytes the device signed (the token, or the EAT's Sig_structure)

device_state.description: the operator's statement of the device's lifecycle; not measured

endorser.description: the endorser's own name (the verifier uses the policy's name for the key)
